beginnerScopes.chapter: Chapter 1 – BC Reads: Adult Literacy Fundamental English – Reader 2
beginnerScopes.text: Many people think that poems are not for them. They may not have read a poem by a good poet. A good poet can make us feel less cut off from the world. A good poet can make us see the world with new eyes. A good poet can make us feel alive.
beginnerScopes.approvalLimit: Complete native original-author paragraph only, no poems/concatenation/modern-history claim or CEFR calibration.

beginnerScopes.chapter: Chapter 1 – BC Reads: Adult Literacy Fundamental English – Reader 2
beginnerScopes.text: Many people think Langston Hughes was a very good poet. Langston was black. He grew up in a time when white people did not treat black people well. So he wrote poems about the need to make a better world. Many people still do not treat black people well. So we still need Langston’s poems. His poems give us hope.
beginnerScopes.approvalLimit: Complete native original-author paragraph only, no poems/concatenation/modern-history claim or CEFR calibration.

beginnerScopes.chapter: The Gentleman Bandit – BC Reads: Adult Literacy Fundamental English – Reader 3
beginnerScopes.text: In the days before cars, people and goods travelled a long way on horses and trains. Horses and trains were easy targets for bandits looking to make easy money. Bill Miner was one of the most feared train bandits. He spent four years of his life here in British Columbia. This is the story of those four years.
beginnerScopes.approvalLimit: Complete native original-author paragraph only, no poems/concatenation/modern-history claim or CEFR calibration.

beginnerScopes.chapter: The Gentleman Bandit – BC Reads: Adult Literacy Fundamental English – Reader 3
beginnerScopes.text: Wanted posters with Bill Miner’s face were put up all over the west coast of the United States. Bill needed to escape. He slipped across the border into Canada. George Edwards was the name he gave anyone who asked who he was. He went from town to town in British Columbia. He had no trouble making friends. He was a charming man. He played the fiddle. He showed people how to dance. He was known as a real gentleman. Nobody thought he could be a bandit.
